name: Erik Karlsson
bio:
Erik Karlsson's motorsport journey began in his youth, fueled by a fascination with engineering and speed. He honed his skills through years of dedicated work, starting as a junior engineer at a small rally team and working his way up through the ranks. Erik's keen eye for detail and innovative approach to problem-solving quickly made him a valuable asset to any team.

At GCK Motorsport, Erik is known for his unwavering commitment to pushing the boundaries of technical innovation. He firmly believes that a combination of meticulous planning and creative thinking is essential for success. His demanding nature ensures that every member of his team strives for excellence, contributing to a culture of continuous improvement and performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted to the side with a slight wave.
physical.description: Erik has a lean build and intense, focused eyes that reflect his dedication to his work.

quirks: Constantly adjusts his glasses, even when they are perfectly aligned.
Has a habit of sketching technical diagrams on napkins during lunch.
Always arrives exactly 15 minutes early for meetings.
